context:
Goal: the sender and the Post button both stay on screen at every text size.
Problem (goal): with the full sender head and the bar, the two together fill the screen at the largest sizes, and dropping the head's other text needs your grant.
Based on (ruling): you answered build B now on the Post bar question, with the note make the pin not so thick (2026-11-18 23:22 CST).
Based on (measured): the designer measured the bar at the default large text size: 128 pt as drawn, 61 pt in one row, 53 pt button only.
Departs from: main shows the full sender head at every size — this shows only the seller at the largest sizes.
Waiting on: your answer; the builder waits on this together with the text cap for the largest sizes.
